This is a very simple marking jig to be used to guide your cut for these triggers to make them compatible with the Hoffman Tactical Super Safety. 

The below triggers should be compatible: 
Rise Armament Single stage drop in triggers like the Rave PCC, Rave 140, etc. 
NOT SURE ABOUT THEIR TWO-STAGE TRIGGERS AND I WOULDN'T WASTE MONEY CONVERTING ONE FOR SUPER SAFE...SORT OF DEFEATS THE PURPOSE?
These will also work with the more budget Aim Surplus SSTAT triggers. These are made by Rise Armament and just a little less fancy. But the profile of the back of the trigger is the same. 

Print the jig, cut the material off, and install in your build. 

This is not sponsored or endorsed by Rise Armament or Aim Surplus. Use this jig at your own risk. DB Does not assume any responsibility for your gunsmiffing.
